summaryOfChanges: All 20 findings from Review 1 successfully addressed in revised design. 10 HIGH findings closed with detailed specifications for algorithms, API responses, WebSocket, bracket progression, batch endpoints, and recommendation logic. 7 MEDIUM findings closed with privacy controls, streak calculation, error handling, carousel spec, and cache invalidation rules. 3 NIT findings closed with MVP phasing, accessibility targets, and success metrics. No new blocking issues identified.

high.title: Leaderboard period filter ambiguous
high.evidence: Added 'Leaderboard Period Definitions' section with ISO 8601 calendar weeks (Mon-Sun UTC), calendar months, all-time. Model updated with period_start_date, period_end_date. Timezone handling clarified: all calculations in UTC.

high.title: API response structure undefined
high.evidence: Defined consistent schema: { success, data, error, errorCode, pagination, meta }. Paginated endpoints include limit, skip, total, page, hasMore. All endpoints documented with error codes for client-side handling.

high.title: WebSocket incomplete
high.evidence: Added full lifecycle: 30s heartbeat, 90s timeout, exponential backoff reconnection (1s→2s→4s→8s up to 60s), messageId acknowledgment, error types (auth_expired, rate_limit, server_error). Client best practices section added.

high.title: Tournament bracket progression undefined
high.evidence: Added 'Bracket Progression Specification': single elimination (MVP), random seeding, auto-advance on match completion, bye logic for odd participants, admin round progression. Schema updated with bracketType, seedingStrategy, totalRounds, currentRound.

high.title: Player profile N+1 risk
high.evidence: Defined batch endpoint: GET /api/players/batch?userIds=id1,id2,... (max 50 IDs). Fallback strategy: if batch unavailable, sequential fetch with 100ms delay. Data enrichment section updated.

high.title: Recommendation algorithm too vague
high.evidence: Added scoring formula: sport_match +30, time_match +20, friends_playing +25, trending +15, skill_match +10. Time inference: if 10+ games, use typical game time ± 2 hours. Error fallback to generic recommendations.

high.title: Tournament signup closure timing unspecified
high.evidence: Clarified: signup_close_time in UTC, hard cutoff (no grace period), error response includes timestamp. UI displays close time in user's local timezone. Error code 'SIGNUPS_CLOSED' specified.

high.title: Bracket conflict resolution incomplete
high.evidence: Added handling: match status check prevents updates on completed matches (200 OK no-op if duplicate), or 409 Conflict with 'BRACKET_CONFLICT' code if conflicting result detected. Admin can post override. Audit logging specified.

high.title: Mobile leaderboard UI underspecified
high.evidence: Defined mobile card layout: rank badge (gold/silver/bronze), avatar, name, points, win rate, streak. Cards fixed-height 120px, full-width, sortable by Points/Win Rate/Games Played, searchable by name. Tap to expand full profile.

high.title: Filter persistence conflict handling missing
high.evidence: Added validation on load: check saved filters against SPORTS config and user membership. Invalid filters silently reset to defaults. FilterBar component tracks invalidFilters state and shows validation errors.

medium.title: Pagination limit inconsistency
medium.evidence: Standardized to limit=50 default (max 100). GET /api/games max 50; GET /api/leaderboards max 100. Reasoning: leaderboards need higher limit for periodic rankings. All endpoints include total, hasMore in response.

medium.title: Social engagement privacy unspecified
medium.evidence: Added privacy_setting field: 'public' | 'private'. Private users: profile visible to followers only. Added blockedBy array. Clarified: followers/following/blocked arrays not exposed in public profile, only counts shown. Blocking is non-mutual.

medium.title: Streak calculation incomplete
medium.evidence: Added detailed function: calculateCurrentStreak() returns streak count, start date, no-show flag. Resets on loss OR no_show. UTC timezone handling. Triggered after each game completion. Code sample provided.

medium.title: Email notifications scope undefined
medium.evidence: Clarified: out of scope for hub design but required for social flow. Template defined: 'Your friend [Name] just joined [Game Name]'. Frequency cap per user preference (daily/weekly/never). Noted for Phase 2 implementation.

medium.title: Carousel interaction underspecified
medium.evidence: Specified: Framer Motion built-in drag detection (no external library). Visible items: <sm: 1, sm: 1.5, md: 2, lg: 3. Auto-rotate 5s (pause on interaction). Dot pagination indicators. Swipe left/right on mobile.

medium.title: Error messages too generic
medium.evidence: All errors include errorCode ('GAME_FULL', 'RATE_LIMITED', 'AUTH_REQUIRED', etc.). Rate limits include retryAfter timestamp. Server 500 errors include errorId for support lookup. Recovery paths specified for each error type.

medium.title: Cache invalidation too vague
medium.evidence: Added explicit 'Cache Invalidation Triggers' section: games (immediate on join/leave, 5min background), leaderboards (immediate on match score, period rollover, 5min), recommendations (immediate on game change, trending update, daily refresh), etc.

nit.title: MVP phasing not mentioned
nit.evidence: Added 'MVP Feature Phasing': Phase 1 (games, hero stats, leaderboard, join flow). Phase 2 (tournaments, recommendations, recent results). Phase 3 (social follow, weekly/monthly leaderboards, profiles). Phase 4 (email, news, algorithm tuning).

nit.title: Accessibility WCAG level not specified
nit.evidence: Targeted WCAG AA compliance. Specified ARIA labels on all interactive elements, keyboard navigation (Tab, Enter), bracket keyboard nav (arrow keys). Note: full validation requires manual testing with screen readers.

nit.title: Success metrics lack baseline
nit.evidence: Expanded to 11 metrics: page load < 2s (Lighthouse), join flow < 3 clicks, leaderboard sort < 100ms, WebSocket latency < 1s, 70% filter engagement, 40% tournament conversion, < 0.5% error rate, etc. Note: current baseline TBD.

verifiedAssumptions.claim: Radix UI Dialog, Avatar, Badge, Button, Card, Input, Label available
verifiedAssumptions.evidence: All present in package.json; used in existing games/page.js
framer-motion@11.18.0 in dependencies; appropriate for specified animations and gestures

verifiedAssumptions.claim: React Query available for caching strategy
verifiedAssumptions.evidence: @tanstack/react-query@5.56.2 in dependencies; suitable for cache invalidation strategy

verifiedAssumptions.claim: Razorpay integration and guest checkout already exist
verifiedAssumptions.evidence: games/page.js implements full Razorpay + guest checkout flow; design preserves this

verifiedAssumptions.claim: SPORTS array with id, name, status defined
verifiedAssumptions.evidence: config.js contains active/disabled/coming_soon sports; design references correctly
config.js shows sport_id referenced in MEMBERSHIPS; aligns with leaderboard design

verifiedAssumptions.claim: useAuth() hook available for extended user context
verifiedAssumptions.evidence: Used in games/page.js; can extend with user.followed_players

verifiedAssumptions.claim: Tailwind, Radix UI, Lucide locked in as foundation
verifiedAssumptions.evidence: All in package.json; design technology stack matches repo

unverifiedAssumptions.assumption: Tournaments collection exists with schema and seeding
unverifiedAssumptions.recommendation: Verify tournaments schema with backend team before sprint. Confirm fields: _id, participants, bracket, status, entry_fee, prize_pool, etc.
Clarify architecture: custom Node.js server for WebSocket (not serverless), or polling-only MVP? Design includes polling fallback, but real-time scope affected.

unverifiedAssumptions.assumption: Leaderboard stats pre-calculated hourly via batch job
unverifiedAssumptions.recommendation: Confirm backend has hourly cron job to calculate leaderboard ranks, tie-breaking, and populate leaderboards collection. If not, budget time to build.

unverifiedAssumptions.assumption: Admin dashboard for posting tournament bracket results exists or in-scope
unverifiedAssumptions.recommendation: Clarify: is admin bracket UI separate task? Hub can show read-only brackets, but feature requires admin tooling to input match results.

implementation_guidance.phasing: Phase 1 (MVP): Games + filters + hero + enhanced cards (~2 weeks). Phase 2: Tournaments + brackets + recommendations (~2 weeks). Phase 3: Social + profiles + leaderboards (~1 week). Phase 4 (stretch): Email + news carousel + algorithm tuning.
pre_sprint_checklist: Confirm tournaments collection schema with backend
Decide: WebSocket + custom server, or polling fallback only?
Verify hourly leaderboard batch job exists or schedule build
Establish current games page load baseline (for success metrics)
If admin UI out-of-scope, clarify how match results will be posted during testing
implementation_guidance.estimated_scope: MVP ~5 weeks (all phases). Phase 1 suitable for 2-week sprint.
